# Balance of Power

*Close minus open over the bar range, -1 to 1.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Balance of Power** under **Oscillators**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Color | color | `"#FF5252"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/bop.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Balance of Power", shortTitle: "BOP", overlay: false, precision: 2 });
plot(ta.calc([candle.open, candle.high, candle.low, candle.close], (o, h, l, c) => (h - l ? (c - o) / (h - l) : 0)), { title: "BOP", color: input.color("Color", "#FF5252", { group: "Style" }) });
hline(0, { title: "Zero", color: "rgba(120,123,134,0.5)", style: "dashed" });
```
